open_questions: qa-analyst: bot_run.gd _buy_wanted needs cash >= fixed_cost + price, so at cash ~114 (fixed 110) it never sets the Buy order: bot deadlock, not a game bug. Dropping the fixed_cost term recovers decent seed 7 (cash 114 to 328 at 30) and dead_run seeds 1, 2, 7. Also the bot buys a permit and plans only system 2 lanes while A1 is not learned (seed 4). Please fix both in the bot and re-run.
Owner: a system 2 permit without skill A1 gives no trade in system 2 (owner rule 2026-11-03). Intended? The permit panel does not warn; only the lock text now names A1.

Owner/economy: fabric can be built before its inputs have a route (P3-fabric-before-inputs). Rule unchanged; panel now says which inputs are not reached. Plate sells at Voltara (plate_sell 120 in planets.json, marked placeholder); nullglass has no buyer in system 1, so it is fabric-only stock.
handoff: No game softlock found. All three softlock entries are bot gaps: the game always left a legal action. Two small panel hints added. Tests 956 pass, 0 fail (3 new checks). No balance or data change.

bug_report.P3-decent-default-7: not a game bug. DIAG at cycle 14: 2 routes stalled 'Source storage is empty', no Buy order at planet 0. Bot rule cash >= fixed 110 + price blocked the Buy. A Buy order costs only what cash allows, so a human can act. Probe with the guard dropped: cash 114 -> 297 at cycle 13, run continues to 30.
bug_report.P3-dead_run-permit-idle: not a game bug, same bot guard. Seeds 1, 2, 7 with the guard relaxed show no idle stretch. Seed 4 is the next entry.
bug_report.P3-dead-chain-scripted-seed4: not a game bug (bot). can_connect for every planned lane returns 'Needs a Space Storage in this system.': the bot bought the permit (3 skill points) so A1 was never learned (learned = B1, C1), and its planner ranks only system 2 lanes. System 1 lanes stay open to a human. Game change: trade_locked_reason() appends 'Learn Space Storage (A1) first.' while A1 is missing (id LBL_TRADE_NEEDS_A1 with English fallback).
bug_report.P3-dead-chain-scripted-seed1: not a bug, by design. A route into Space Storage is a pass-through (stock only, pays -trip -upkeep, no income). Income is on a Sell order at a planet in that system: Sell draws from Space Storage (sell_available). Dross sells at Voltara 18 and Ashgate 15. Nullglass has no buyer in system 1, so it is fabric input only. New test proves a Voltara dross Sell order pays out of the station. The displayed route net -104 is the route alone. Open for economy: whether dross to the station should show an expected sale.
bug_report.P3-dead-chain-plate: open, economy-designer. Game path works (fabric makes plate, tests pass). Misses come from cash and ship cap, not a game fault.
bug_report.P3-fabric-before-inputs: rule unchanged. Station panel now shows 'Inputs not reached yet: dross, nullglass. Send them here from a dead world.' when stock is short and no route feeds the station (node FabricInputs, id SS_FABRIC_NO_INPUTS fallback). Owner decision on a hard rule still open.
bug_report.P3-decent-permit-win-band: open, economy-designer (bot vs sim gap; the Buy guard bot gap above may lower the bot win rate).
bug_report.P3-dead-ship-cap: open, owner: should a dead route take a slot ahead of a standing route. Game refuses with 'No ship available'; not changed.
bug_report.P3-notice-DEAD_UNLOCK: open, low. Posted at end of cycle 14 (suite checks it). Not re-probed in a long queue.
bug_report.P3-qa-bot-plate-sell: not a game gap. Plate has a Sell order at Voltara (planet_1 plate_sell 120, tested at the fabric test). The bot sets none: qa-analyst.
